hints.title: Chessboard Coordinate Parity
hints.text: Every square color is determined by the parity of the sum of its column index and row index.

hints.title: Color Equivalence
hints.text: Two squares share the same color if and only if their parity values are identical.

hints.title: Reference Implementation
hints.text:
```python
class Solution:
    def checkTwoChessboards(self, coordinate1: str, coordinate2: str) -> bool:
        c1 = (ord(coordinate1[0]) - ord('a') + int(coordinate1[1])) % 2
        c2 = (ord(coordinate2[0]) - ord('a') + int(coordinate2[1])) % 2
        return c1 == c2
```
